547: /* Remove a rule from the retained command rules. Always match rules
548:  * verbatim, but also remove subcommand rules if we are adding or removing the 
549:  * entire command. */
550: void ACLSelectorRemoveCommandRule(aclSelector *selector, sds new_rule) {
551:     size_t new_len = sdslen(new_rule);
552:     char *existing_rule = selector->command_rules;
553: 
554:     /* Loop over the existing rules, trying to find a rule that "matches"
555:      * the new rule. If we find a match, then remove the command from the string by
556:      * copying the later rules over it. */
557:     while(existing_rule[0]) {
558:         /* The first character of the rule is +/-, which we don't need to compare. */
559:         char *copy_position = existing_rule;
560:         existing_rule += 1;
561: 
562:         /* Assume a trailing space after a command is part of the command, like '+get ', so trim it
563:          * as well if the command is removed. */
564:         char *rule_end = strchr(existing_rule, ' ');
565:         if (!rule_end) {
566:             /* This is the last rule, so it it to the end of the string. */
567:             rule_end = existing_rule + strlen(existing_rule);
568: 
569:             /* This approach can leave a trailing space if the last rule is removed,
570:              * but only if it's not the first rule, so handle that case. */
571:             if (copy_position != selector->command_rules) copy_position -= 1;
572:         }
573:         char *copy_end = rule_end;
574:         if (*copy_end == ' ') copy_end++;

576:         /* Exact match or the rule we are comparing is a subcommand denoted by '|' */
577:         size_t existing_len = rule_end - existing_rule;
578:         if (!memcmp(existing_rule, new_rule, min(existing_len, new_len))) {
579:             if ((existing_len == new_len) || (existing_len > new_len && (existing_rule[new_len]) == '|')) {

581:                  * deleted, including the terminating NULL character. */

Fixed ACL command-rule cleanup in `src/acl.c`.

  'cd /testbed && make -C src -B -j2 redis-server && ./runtest --single unit/acl'
